facts.text: The resort has grand Mexican Colonial architecture stretching across 65 acres of the Sonoran Desert.
facts.excerpt: The property is an homage to Southwestern elegance with its grand Mexican Colonial architecture stretching across 65 acres of the Sonoran Desert.

facts.text: The resort is adjacent to the TPC Scottsdale complex, home to the PGA Tour's WM Phoenix Open.
facts.excerpt: Its location adjacent to the TPC Scottsdale complex—home to the PGA Tour’s renowned WM Phoenix Open—brings serious golfers to the property.

facts.text: Chef Richard Sandoval is behind two of the resort's restaurants.
facts.excerpt: Prolific Mexican chef and restaurateur Richard Sandoval is behind two of the five restaurants on the property.

facts.text: Toro, in the clubhouse of the TPC course, serves Latin American fare blended with Japanese offerings and has a patio overlooking the fairway and the McDowell Mountains.
facts.excerpt: At Toro, located in the clubhouse of the TPC course with a patio overlooking both the fairway and the McDowell Mountain Range, Sandoval focuses on Latin American fare blended with Japanese offerings.

facts.text: La Hacienda is a dinner-only Mexican restaurant on the resort's plaza.
facts.excerpt: His dinner-only Mexican eatery La Hacienda sits on the resort’s plaza with multiple patios outside, plus beehive fireplaces, wood-beamed ceilings, and a dedicated tequila bar

facts.text: The resort also has Ironwood American Kitchen, Plaza Bar and Michael Mina's Bourbon Steak.
facts.excerpt: You’ll also find the all-day Ironwood American Kitchen, casual Plaza Bar, and Michael Mina’s Bourbon Steak on the property.

facts.text: The Sisley-Paris Spa is a spa within the resort's spa and is one of the few Sisley outposts in the country.
facts.excerpt: For a skincare splurge, book a treatment at the Sisley-Paris Spa, the Fairmont’s spa within a spa, and one of the few Sisley outposts in the country.

facts.text: The spa's locker rooms have steam rooms, dry saunas, hot tubs and cold plunges, and the spa has a rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: steam rooms, dry saunas, hot tubs, and cold plunges in the locker rooms, as well as a tranquil rooftop pool

facts.text: The Sonoran Splash pool is geared toward kids and has twisting water slides.
facts.excerpt: especially the kid-centric Sonoran Splash pool with twisting water slides

facts.text: The Sunset Beach pool has sand imported from Florida, and a supervised kids club for ages 5 through 12 is available for an extra cost.
facts.excerpt: the Sunset Beach pool—with sand imported from Florida—is a fun spot for little ones to play, too. There’s also a supervised kids club (for ages 5 through 12) available for an extra cost

facts.text: Privado Studio villas have a private entrance, a gas fireplace and a soaking bathtub.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive villas with private entrance. Studio style, patio or balcony, sofa bed, gas fireplace, soaking bathtub, dual vanities, Nespresso maker.

facts.text: Fairmont View rooms have a balcony with golf course views.
facts.excerpt: Balcony with golf course views. Oversized shower, dual vanities, Nespresso maker, refreshment bar, mini-fridge, steamer. Located on floors 2-4.

facts.text: Fairmont Gold Jr Suites include lounge access with complimentary breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Lounge access with complimentary breakfast. Studio style, patio or balcony, sofa bed, bathtub, oversized shower, dual vanities, Nespresso maker.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the resort's size means service is attentive and prompt but not intimate.
facts.excerpt: With a resort of this size servicing thousands of guests on any given day, you’re not going to get intimate, know-your-name service—but service is attentive and prompt.

facts.text: The resort is massive and draws a cross section of guests, including many business travelers attending conferences.
facts.excerpt: Such a massive resort—with such a multitude of offerings—lends itself to a cross section of guests, including a good chunk of business travelers

facts.text: The resort is in North Scottsdale, an upscale suburban area, a few miles from high-end shopping and dining complexes.
facts.excerpt: Located in the ever-growing neighborhood of North Scottsdale, an upscale suburban area with lots of large estates and gated communities, the Princess is a few miles from clusters of high-end shopping and dining complexes

facts.text: The resort charges a resort fee that includes afternoon access to the rec center.
facts.excerpt: afternoon access to the rec center is included in the resort fee.
